nouveautes.resume: Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) is a rare cause of meningoencephalitis in humans. Although LCMV is a rodent zoonosis with a global distribution, no UK cases in humans have been reported in published literature since the 1950s, and testing is rarely performed. LCMV meningoencephalitis is self-limiting in people who are immunocompetent, but infection in hosts who are immunocompromised causes severe disease.

nouveautes.titre: Feasibility and clinical outcomes of routine point-of-care screening for opportunistic infections among people with advanced HIV disease in Guyana.
nouveautes.resume: We evaluated the feasibility and outcomes of implementing comprehensive Point-of-care (POC) opportunistic infections (OIs) screening among people with Advanced HIV disease (AHD) in Guyana. Only 37.5% of participants with positive results completed the disease-specific diagnostic workup, and 41.7% initiated directed treatment for the detected OI. Routine POC screening for OIs among people with AHD in Guyana is feasible and detects a high burden of OIs.

nouveautes.resume: Rapid and accurate prediction of Mycobacterium tuberculosis drug resistance is crucial for effective tuberculosis control. nouveautes.resume: We evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) during 2010-2025 in Ceará State, Brazil. Our findings provide an epidemiologic baseline for postlicensure dengue vaccine evaluation.
